evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫 (Multi-function Chinese Character Database)
evidence.field: 形義通解; 《廣韻》; cited examples
evidence.text: The entry analyzes 呢 as 口 semantic + 尼 phonetic and records the particle use. It gives 女夷切 and classifies the reading in Middle Chinese as 娘母, level tone, 止攝脂韻, open, division III. Cited examples from 儒林外史 and 紅樓夢 show question-final and affirmative sentence-final uses, respectively; these examples do not establish the first attestation of either particle function. The entry also lists a woollen-cloth noun sense without dating it.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫 - 字頭「呢」

evidence.source: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.field: 研訂瀏覽; cited 玉篇 and 集韻 entries; 形體資料表
evidence.text: The entry quotes 玉篇 for 呢, 女知切, glossed 呢喃小聲多言也 (“soft, low, much speech”). It cites 集韻 for an alternative graph in which the phonetic component is replaced by 貳, and describes another variant with a colloquial 尼 shape. The page lists later reference collections with some image records, but the early oracle-bone, bronze, and other ancient-character collections are marked unavailable; it does not provide an early origin form or demonstrate graphic corruption.
evidence.title: A00558 呢 - 教育部《異體字字典》

evidence.source: Taiwan Ministry of Education, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.field: 研究頁所引《玉篇》; 《宋元以來俗字譜》
evidence.text: The variant-dictionary entry provides a medieval lexicographic record for 呢 and points to a form in 《宋元以來俗字譜》 citing 目連記. It does not date the character's invention or the first particle use.
evidence.title: A00558 呢 - 教育部《異體字字典》

evidence.source: Chen, Zhenning and Zhenyu Chen, Current Research in Chinese Linguistics 101(2)
evidence.field: Abstract; historical analysis of 呢 mood particle
evidence.text: The 2022 article examines competing accounts of the particle's functions and historical source. Its abstract argues that Beijing Mandarin ne is not a topic-only-question marker and that its functions mainly developed from exclamation. This is a scholarly proposal about spoken particle development, distinct from the graphic analysis of 呢 as 口 + 尼; it does not establish that the graph originated from the particle or identify a depicted object whose name supplied the phonetic value.
evidence.title: The Study of the Origin of the Mood Particle Ne (呢) Based on the Development of Topic-only Questions

evidence.text: The supplied exact local table rows for 尼 list MC nejX / OC *nˤərʔ (“to stop”), MC nejH / OC *nˤərʔ-s (“to stop, obstruct”), and MC nrij / OC *nr[əj] (“near, close”). No 呢 row was supplied. These readings are Baxter–Sagart 2014 notation and cannot be merged with the dossier's Zhengzhang *nil for 呢 or with the separate *nil for 尼 reported in another system. search_audit.outcome: Inspected the 2022 particle study and MOE source. Search surfaced a digitized textbook listing 呢 as 'woollen cloth' but did not establish its publication context from an inspected description page or date its first Chinese use. Cloth-word etymology and date remain unresolved.

gaps: No historical glyph item is proposed: external searches did not establish a character-specific, reusable, direct image candidate with exact identity and rights provenance. Xiaoxuetang's general interface is insufficient without a specific form record; Commons results were unrelated. The MOE page's glyph assets are under a site that states all rights reserved.

Early graphic history remains unresolved. The MOE variant page lists several reference collections but marks early oracle, bronze, and other ancient-form records unavailable. No inspected source establishes the first written form or any graphic corruption.

The traditional graphic account 口 semantic + 尼 phonetic is supported by the CUHK entry and medieval lexicographic evidence. The characters' local current Mandarin readings are ne for 呢 and ní for 尼, but the official Unicode click-through records were inaccessible. Unihan current readings are metadata, not proof of ancient phonetic correspondence.

The local Baxter–Sagart table has several 尼 readings and no supplied 呢 row. Dossier Zhengzhang *nil and Baxter–Sagart readings are separate reconstruction systems; a matching Baxter–Sagart compound-host reading was not verified, so no Baxter–Sagart sound comparison is asserted.

Particle-source accounts remain disputed. The new 2022 study proposes development mainly from exclamation; dossier sources also report proposals involving 爾/聻/尼 and 裏/哩. These are proposals about spoken particles, not established derivations of the graph. First attestations and every proposed link were not independently checked here.

The cloth sense is listed by CUHK and appears as 'woollen cloth' in a nineteenth-century English-Chinese textbook search result, but its exact bibliographic context was not inspected sufficiently to date the Chinese sense or determine whether it shares a graph history with the particle. No lexical origin claim is made.
The Cantonese demonstrative comparison set and proposed English-level clipping in the dossier were not verified. They are not evidence about the graphic formation of 呢.

No independent source here establishes an original depicted object or its name/pronunciation for any whole-graph loan theory. The supported evidence concerns a phonetic component within 呢 and separate spoken particle hypotheses; no object-name loan is inferred.

limitations.text: No image selected because the searched sources did not yield a character-specific direct image URL with verifiable identity and reuse rights. The MOE page lists forms from historical dictionaries but states its copyright; Xiaoxuetang's queried homepage and convention page did not supply an exact record image for 呢. No unrelated Commons glyph was substituted.
